name: EconoFil (Filaments.ca house brand)
summary: Budget house brand of Canadian retailer Filaments.ca, covering PLA (standard, silk, matte, glow, 3D850), PETG, PETG-CF, ABS, ASA, TPU and TPE, with a refill-coil system on reusable master spools since 2018. Filaments.ca says it makes some of its own filament and imports others; which applies to EconoFil is not stated.

oem_relationships.notes: EconoFil is sold as Filaments.ca's own brand on filaments.ca (https://filaments.ca/pages/econofil-pla). Legal entity name not given on the about page.

additional_notes: The actual extruder is unidentified. No suspected-manufactured-by relationship is encoded because Filaments.ca states it extrudes some filament itself, so there is no positive evidence that EconoFil is contract-made. A HardwareCanucks forum snippet mentions a PLA batch recall notice (batch BI06CA), not confirmed on company pages.

provenance.conflicts: Whether EconoFil is extruded in-house by Filaments.ca or imported is unstated; HQ city unknown; recall notice unverified.
